content.text: {"id": "mm5546a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of black adults not meeting recommended HbA1c levels declined from 79.2% to 55.7%."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of persons using insulin significantly decreased, from 47.6% to 39.6% (p<0.01)."}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion of the population self-reporting diabetes who were obese (BMI > 30) increased significantly (p<0.05)"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "The proportion not meeting recommended LDL cholesterol levels declined from 49.9% to 18.5%,"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The one risk factor that did not improve was smoking; prevalence remained at approximately 46%."}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The analyses described in this report examined whether glycemic and lipid control improved in both communities from 1997 to 2004,"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "no overall significant differences in glycemic or lipid levels or in BMI were found between residents in southeast Raleigh and Greensboro."}]}, {"v": "stratified/adjusted", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "These results were then age standardized to the 2000 U.S. Census population, which yielded consistent results,"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "cross-sectional, population-based health surveys were conducted in person in two predominately black communities"}]}, {"v": "before/after or trend", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The analyses described in this report examined whether glycemic and lipid control improved in both communities from 1997 to 2004,"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "the two-sided Student's t-test was used to test the hypothesis that proportions were equal in the two surveys."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data were weighted to reflect the age, sex, and racial/ethnic composition of the study population based on the 2000 U.S. Census population."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "These results were then age standardized to the 2000 U.S. Census population, which yielded consistent results,"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
